Official notification issued Advt. 05/2026
UPESSC Assistant Teacher Recruitment 2026
Recruitment covers 11,508 Urban Assistant Teacher and 897 Sambaddh Primary Assistant Teacher posts. The fee payment deadline has been extended to 04 November 2026, and the application correction window remains open until 31 October 2026. Candidates must complete OTR and submit their applications through the official UPESSC portal.
Uttar Pradesh Shiksha Seva Chayan Aayog (UPESSC), Prayagraj, has released Advertisement No. 05/2026 for the Chayan Pariksha (Selection Examination) 2026 for the posts of Assistant Teacher, Primary, Urban (under the Basic Education Department) and Assistant Teacher, Sambaddh Primary (Boys/Girls, Non-Government Aided Schools, under the Secondary Education Department).
In brief: UPESSC is recruiting for 12,405 Assistant Teacher posts - 11,508 Assistant Teacher (Urban) posts under the Basic Education Department (district-wise, across 75 UP districts) and 897 Assistant Teacher Sambaddh Primary posts (473 in boys' schools + 424 in girls' schools) under the Secondary Education Department. Candidates with a graduate degree plus a recognised teaching qualification (B.T.C./D.El.Ed. or equivalent) and a qualifying TET score, aged 21–40 years (Urban post) or minimum 21 years (Sambaddh Primary post), can apply. Online registration (OTR) starts 16.09.2026, and the last date for fee payment has been extended to 04.11.2026, with correction window until 31.10.2026. The written exam is tentatively scheduled for 3 & 4 December 2026. Applications are online only, via www.upessc.up.gov.in.

UPESSC Assistant Teacher (Urban) Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
There are 12,405 total vacancies across two post categories. The number of vacancies may increase or decrease.
Assistant Teacher, Primary, Urban - District-wise & Category-wise Vacancy (Selected Districts)
Category-wise total (all 75 districts): UR-4,746, EWS-1,116, OBC-3,069, SC-2,379, ST-198. The full district-wise breakup (all 75 districts of Uttar Pradesh) is available in Table-1 of the official advertisement on www.upessc.up.gov.in. Horizontal reservation within these totals includes 429 posts for Persons with Disabilities (Handicap), 97 posts for Dependents of Freedom Fighters, and 540 posts for Ex-Servicemen.
Assistant Teacher, Sambaddh Primary (Non-Government Aided Schools) - Vacancy
Grand Total (both post categories): 12,405 posts. The Basic Education Department has identified the Urban post as suitable for PwBD candidates under VI/LI/HI/THALASSEMIA sub-categories. The Sambaddh Primary post has been identified suitable for a wider set of PwBD sub-categories: O.A/O.L/B/B.A/L.V/D/H.H/L.C/D.W/A.A.V/A.S.D/S.L.D/I.D/M.I/B.L/B.L.A/B.H/M.D.Y.
UPESSC Assistant Teacher (Urban) Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
UPESSC Assistant Teacher (Urban) Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
Only the birth date recorded on the High School (or equivalent) certificate will be considered valid - no other document will be accepted for date of birth.
Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

UPESSC Assistant Teacher (Urban) Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
Fee can be paid via Credit Card, Debit Card, or Net Banking through the online payment gateway available on the portal, immediately after registration.
Fee payment is confirmed only after bank confirmation is received; the fee receipt must be retained.
If a candidate completes One Time Registration (OTR) and fee payment but does not complete the application form by the final date, the application will not be considered valid.
UPESSC Assistant Teacher (Urban) Recruitment 2026 Exam Pattern & Selection Process
Selection for both posts is based on a Merit List prepared from a written examination of 360 marks , comprising 120 objective-type (MCQ) questions .
Each question has 4 options, with only one correct answer to be marked on the OMR sheet using a black ball-point pen.
Marking scheme: 3 marks awarded for each correct answer; 1 mark deducted for each wrong or multiple answer (negative marking).
The question paper will be bilingual - in both Hindi and English.
If the exam is held in multiple shifts, a score Normalization process will be applied (as per Commission notice No. Shiksha Seva Aayog/2018/2025-26 dated 26.02.2026) to enable fair comparison across shifts; only normalized scores will be used for selection.
Tie-breaker rule: In case of equal merit, preference is given first to the candidate with a higher Graduation percentage, then to a higher Training Qualification percentage, and finally to the older candidate by age.
Detailed exam syllabus is available for download on the official website, www.upessc.up.gov.in.
No Travelling Allowance (TA) is payable for appearing in the written exam or for document verification.
How to Apply for UPESSC Assistant Teacher (Urban) Recruitment 2026
Visit the official website, www.upessc.up.gov.in.
Complete One Time Registration (OTR) - mandatory before filling the application; OTR done on any other/older portal will not be valid.
Use the online payment gateway to pay the applicable examination fee via Credit/Debit Card or Net Banking.
Fill in the application form carefully and completely, in English only, indicating your preference between the two school-type options (Urban / Sambaddh Primary) - this preference cannot be changed after the deadline.
Upload a scanned signature on a white background (JPG/JPEG, 10 KB–200 KB, 140x110 pixel resolution) and a scanned passport-size photograph (JPG/JPEG, 30 KB–300 KB, 300–600 pixel resolution).
Upload all required certificates/documents in PDF format, each between 50 KB and 500 KB in size.
Review all entered details carefully - after final submission, changes to category, sub-category, date of birth, or gender will not be permitted.
Use the correction window (until 31.10.2026) only for correcting genuine errors; fees paid against an erroneous application are non-refundable and non-adjustable.
Submit the application and retain 3 printed copies for future reference - 2 of these copies, along with the required documents, must be submitted at the time of Document Verification.
UPESSC Assistant Teacher (Urban) Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
Candidates must hold the essential qualifications by the last date of application submission; those who do not meet the minimum qualification apply at their own risk and responsibility.
The Commission does not provide individual advice regarding a candidate's eligibility - candidates must study the advertisement carefully and apply only if satisfied that they meet all conditions.
Applications with photos/signatures not uploaded per the prescribed size/format, or without an accepted declaration, will be rejected.
If a candidate's declaration in the application is later found to be false, the candidature will be cancelled and the candidate may be debarred from this and future Commission examinations/selections, along with other penal action.
Reserved-category (UP) candidates must clearly indicate their category in the application; if a candidate is eligible for more than one reservation category, only the more beneficial relaxation will be granted.
Reserved-category candidates who are not original residents of Uttar Pradesh are not eligible for category-based relaxation and will be treated as General category.
OBC-NCL certificates must be valid for the period 2026-27 as specified; caste/EWS/PwBD certificates must be in the UP Government-prescribed formats (Annexures 1 to 6 in the official advertisement).
Candidates must obtain a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their current employer, to be submitted at the time of document verification if demanded by the Commission.
Married candidates having more than one living spouse are not eligible, unless exempted by the Governor.
Candidates must be in good mental and physical health, free from any defect that would interfere with efficient discharge of duties; a medical fitness certificate from a Government hospital/PHC medical officer will be required before final selection.
Admit cards, exam date, time, and centre information will be communicated via SMS, email, newspaper, and the website/portal; candidates must appear at their allotted centre only - no request for centre change will be entertained.
Persons with Disabilities (PwBD) candidates are entitled to a Scribe facility (as per Government Orders dated 04.12.2019 and 08.09.2022) and 20 minutes' extra time per hour; the scribe facility requires registration with the Commission office at least one week before the exam.

UPESSC Assistant Teacher (Urban) Recruitment 2026 FAQs
Q1. What is UPESSC Assistant Teacher (Urban) Recruitment 2026?
It is a recruitment notification (Advt. No. 05/2026) by the Uttar Pradesh Shiksha Seva Chayan Aayog for filling 12,405 Assistant Teacher posts - 11,508 in Urban Primary Schools under the Basic Education Department, and 897 in Sambaddh (Aided) Primary Schools under the Secondary Education Department.
Q2. How many vacancies are there in UPESSC Advt No. 05/2026?
There are 12,405 total vacancies: 11,508 for Assistant Teacher, Primary, Urban (across 75 UP districts), and 897 for Assistant Teacher, Sambaddh Primary (473 in boys' schools, 424 in girls' schools).
Q3. What is the last date to apply for UPESSC Assistant Teacher Recruitment 2026?
Online registration begins 16.09.2026; the last date for online fee payment is 04.11.2026, and the correction window closes 31.10.2026.
Q4. What is the qualification required for UPESSC Assistant Teacher posts?
Candidates need a graduate degree plus a recognised teaching qualification (B.T.C./D.El.Ed. or equivalent, as per NCTE norms), and must have qualified the Teacher Eligibility Test (TET) for Classes 1 to 5.
Q5. What is the age limit for UPESSC Assistant Teacher (Urban) Recruitment 2026?
For the Urban post, the age limit is 21–40 years as on 01.07.2026, with 5 years' relaxation for UP's SC/ST/OBC candidates and 15 years for PwBD candidates. For the Sambaddh Primary post, the minimum age is 21 years, with a superannuation age of 62 years.
Q6. What is the application fee for UPESSC Assistant Teacher Recruitment 2026?
The fee is ₹1,000 for General/OBC/EWS candidates, ₹500 for SC/ST candidates, and ₹300 for PwBD candidates.
Q7. What is the exam pattern for UPESSC Assistant Teacher Recruitment 2026?
The written exam is of 360 marks with 120 objective-type MCQs, for a duration of 2 hours, with 3 marks for each correct answer and 1 mark deducted for each wrong/multiple answer.
Q8. What is the salary for UPESSC Assistant Teacher posts?
Both posts carry a pay scale of Level-6, ₹35,400–₹1,12,400 per the 7th CPC pay matrix.
Q9. How can I apply online for UPESSC Assistant Teacher Recruitment 2026?
Candidates must complete One Time Registration (OTR) on www.upessc.up.gov.in, pay the fee online, fill the application form in English, upload the required photo/signature/documents, and submit before the deadline.
Q10. When is the UPESSC Assistant Teacher (Urban) written exam scheduled?
The written examination is tentatively scheduled for 3 and 4 December 2026.
